# awsappstream_sessions (Data Source)

Reads active AppStream streaming sessions for a specific stack and fleet. This data source is read-only and can be used for observability, monitoring, and debugging purposes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# minimal sessions
data "awsappstream_sessions" "example" {
  stack_name = "example-stack"
  fleet_name = "example-fleet"
}
```

```terraform
# full sessions
data "awsappstream_sessions" "example" {
  stack_name = "example-stack"
  fleet_name = "example-fleet"

  user_id             = "example-user-id"
  authentication_type = "USERPOOL"
  instance_id         = "example-instance-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fleet_name` (String) The name of the AppStream fleet for which streaming sessions are listed.
- `stack_name` (String) The name of the AppStream stack for which streaming sessions are listed.

### Optional

- `authentication_type` (String) The authentication method used by the user. Valid values are `API`, `SAML`, `USERPOOL`, or `AWS_AD`.
- `instance_id` (String) The identifier of the streaming instance hosting the session.
- `user_id` (String) The identifier of the user for whom streaming sessions are listed. If specified, `authentication_type` must also be provided.

### Read-Only

- `sessions` (Attributes Set) The list of active streaming sessions that match the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_type` (String) The authentication method used for the session.
- `connection_state` (String) Indicates whether the user is currently connected to the streaming session.
- `fleet_name` (String) The name of the AppStream fleet associated with the session.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the streaming session.
- `instance_id` (String) The identifier of the instance hosting the streaming session.
- `max_expiration_time` (String) The timestamp when the streaming session is scheduled to expire, in RFC 3339 format.
- `network_access_configuration` (Attributes) Network details of the elastic network interface attached to the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions--network_access_configuration))
- `stack_name` (String) The name of the AppStream stack associated with the session.
- `start_time` (String) The timestamp when the streaming session started, in RFC 3339 format.
- `state` (String) The current state of the streaming session.
- `user_id` (String) The identifier of the user for whom the session was created.

<a id="nestedatt--sessions--network_access_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions.network_access_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `eni_id` (String) The identifier of the elastic network interface.
- `eni_ipv6_addresses` (Set of String) The IPv6 addresses assigned to the elastic network interface.
- `eni_private_ip_address` (String) The private IP address of the elastic network interface.
